KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:200/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:200/r2.claim: Muslims are indirectly urged to reject that custom and remember, praise, and thank God even more strongly than idolaters remembered their ancestors.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:200/r2.anchor: Müslümanlar, dolaylı bir biçimde bu yanlış uygulamayı reddetmeye, bunun yerine müşriklerin atalarını anmalarından daha güçlü bir biçimde Allah’a hamd ve şükredip O’nu anmaya çağrılmaktadır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:200/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:200/r3.speaker: İbn Abbas, Atâ
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:200/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas and Ata offer a general reading: remember God lovingly and vividly, like small children remember their fathers and expect care, support, and help, or even more strongly, seeking refuge and help from God.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:200/r3.anchor: İbn Abbas ve Atâ gibi âlimlere isnat edilen başka bir yoruma göre âyetin anlamı genel olup

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:200/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:200/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:200/r4.claim: The world-only supplicants’ requested goods are left unspecified because they seek this world indiscriminately and have become its servants; they neglect the afterlife and receive no share in it.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:2:200/r4.anchor: bu şekilde dua edenlerin, iyi-kötü ayırımı yapmadan sadece “Bize dünyada ver” dedikleri bildirilmiş, fakat ne istedikleri belirtilmemiştir

NAHHAS:v1p295/r16.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p295/r16.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v1p295/r16.claim: «مناسككم» is pronounced with clear separation because the second consonant is like an independent word; assimilation is also allowed here.
NAHHAS:v1p295/r16.anchor: بالإظهار لأن الثاني بمنزلة المنفصل ويجوز ( مناسكم ) بالإدغام

NAHHAS:v1p295/r17.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p295/r17.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v1p295/r17.claim: Unlike «مناسككم», the assimilation in «أينما تكونوا يدرككم الموت» is obligatory.
NAHHAS:v1p295/r17.anchor: أينما تكونوا يدركم الموت فلا يكون إلا مدغما

NAHHAS:v1p295/r18.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p295/r18.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v1p295/r18.claim: The kāf is accusative as a verbal-noun modifier, meaning “remembering like your remembrance of your fathers”; it may also be circumstantial.
NAHHAS:v1p295/r18.anchor: ( فاذكروا الله كذكركم آباءكم ) الكاف في موضع نصب أي ذكرا كذكركم

NAHHAS:v1p295/r19.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p295/r19.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v1p295/r19.claim: «أشد» may be genitive coordinated to «ذكركم», with an implied kāf, or accusative in the sense “or remember Him more intensely”; «ذكرا» specifies it.
NAHHAS:v1p295/r19.anchor: أشد في موضع خفض عطفا على ذكركم والمعنى أو كأشد ذكرا

NAHHAS:v1p295/r20.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p295/r20.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v1p295/r20.claim: «أشد» is diptote because it is an adjective on the «أفعل» pattern.
NAHHAS:v1p295/r20.anchor: ولم ينصرف لأنه أفعل صفة ويجوز أن يكون في موضع نصب

NAHHAS:v1p295/r21.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p295/r21.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v1p295/r21.claim: «من الناس» is nominative either as a subject or as an adjective.
NAHHAS:v1p295/r21.anchor: ( فمن الناس من ) في موضع رفع بالابتداء وإن شئت بالصفة

NAHHAS:v1p295/r22.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p295/r22.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v1p295/r22.claim: «يقول ربنا آتنا» is the relative clause attached to «من».

NAHHAS:v1p295/r23.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v1p295/r23.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v1p295/r23.claim: The «من» before «خلاق» is extra for emphasis.
NAHHAS:v1p295/r23.anchor: ( وما له في الآخرة من خلاق ) من زائدة للتوكيد

BURHAN:v1p255/r7.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p255/r7.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p255/r7.claim: A single word contains two kāfs without an intervening letter only in the cited forms مناسككم and ما سلككم.
BURHAN:v1p255/r7.anchor: ليس فيه كافان فى كلمة واحدة لا حرف بينهما إلا فى موضعين فى البقرة

BURHAN:v1p255/r8.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p255/r8.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p255/r8.claim: The placement of verses within each sūra, including its opening basmala, is fixed by prophetic instruction and must not be rearranged.
BURHAN:v1p255/r8.anchor: وأما ما يتعلق بترتيبه فأما الآيات فى كل سورة وضع البسملة أوائلها فترتيبها توقيفى بلا شك ولا خلاف فيه ولهذا لا يجوز تعكيسها

BURHAN:v1p255/r9.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p255/r9.speaker: مكي وغيره
BURHAN:v1p255/r9.claim: Makkī and others say the Prophet arranged the verses within sūras; no basmala opened al-Tawba because he did not order one there.
BURHAN:v1p255/r9.anchor: قال مكى وغيره ترتيب الآيات فى السور هو من النبى صلى الله عليه وسلم ولما لم يأمر بذلك فى أول براءة تركت بلا بسملة

BURHAN:v1p255/r10.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p255/r10.speaker: القاضي أبو بكر
BURHAN:v1p255/r10.claim: Abū Bakr al-Qāḍī calls verse placement obligatory and binding, saying Gabriel instructed where each verse should go.
BURHAN:v1p255/r10.anchor: وقال القاضى أبو بكر ترتيب الأيات أمر واجب وحكم لازم فقد كان جبريل يقول ضعوا آية كذا فى موضع كذا

BURHAN:v1p255/r11.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p255/r11.speaker: البيهقي عن زيد بن ثابت
BURHAN:v1p255/r11.claim: Zayd ibn Thābit reports that they were compiling the Qur’an around the Prophet when he mentioned the angels spreading their wings over Syria.
BURHAN:v1p255/r11.anchor: وأسند البيهقى فى كتاب المدخل والدلائل عن زيد بن ثابت قال كنا حول رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نؤلف القرآن

BURHAN:v1p255/r12.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p255/r12.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p255/r12.claim: The report likely describes arranging scattered revealed verses into their sūras at the Prophet’s direction.
BURHAN:v1p255/r12.anchor: قال وهذا يشبه أن يكون المراد به تأليف ما نزل من الآيات المتفرقة فى سورها وجمعها فيها بإشارة النبى صلى الله عليه وسلم

BURHAN:v1p255/r13.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p255/r13.speaker: الحاكم
BURHAN:v1p255/r13.claim: Al-Ḥākim judged the report sound according to the conditions of al-Bukhārī and Muslim, though they did not include it.
BURHAN:v1p255/r13.anchor: وأخرجه الحاكم فى المستدرك وقال صحيح على شرط الشيخين ولم يخرجاه

BURHAN:v1p255/r14.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p255/r14.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p255/r14.claim: The Qur’an was gathered in stages: some in the Prophet’s presence, another collection under Abū Bakr, and the arrangement of sūras under ʿUthmān.
BURHAN:v1p255/r14.anchor: وقل فيه البيان الواضح أن جمع القرآن لم يكن مرة واحدة فقد جمع بعضه بحضرة النبى صلى الله عليه وسلم ثم جمع بحضرة أبى بكر الصديق والجمع الثالث وهو ترتيب السور كان بحضرة عثمان

BURHAN:v1p255/r15.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p255/r15.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p255/r15.claim: Authorities differ whether ʿUthmān’s codex followed Zayd’s or Ubayy’s reading; most transmitters favor Zayd, and “Zayd’s ḥarf” means his reading and method.
BURHAN:v1p255/r15.anchor: واختلف فى الحرف الذى كتب عثمان عليه المصحف فقيل حرف زيد بن ثابت وقيل حرف أبى بن كعب لأنه العرضة الأخيرة

BURHAN:v4p282/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p282/r2.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p282/r2.claim: An objection proposes that the sīn may mark a worldly promise while sawfa marks a promise for the afterlife.
BURHAN:v4p282/r2.anchor: ولمانع إن يمنعه مستندا إلى إن الله تعالى وعد المؤمنين احوال خير في الدنيا والاخرة فجاز إن يكون ما قرن بالسين لما في الدنيا وما قرن بسوف لما في الاخرة

ITQAN:v3p182#2/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p182#2/r2.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p182#2/r2.claim: “Remember Him as He guided you” may signal repeating the remembrance a second and third time, or may refer to the circumambulation of ifada because “when you finish your rites” follows it.
ITQAN:v3p182#2/r2.anchor: إشارة إلى تكرره ثانيا وثالثا ويحتمل أن يراد به طواف الإفاضة

ITQAN:v3p182#2/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p182#2/r3.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p182#2/r3.claim: The remembrance after completing the rites refers to stoning Jamrat al-Aqaba; the later remembrance on numbered days refers to stoning during the days of tashriq.
ITQAN:v3p182#2/r3.anchor: والذكر الثالث إشارة إلى رمي جمرة العقبة والذكر الأخير لرمي أيام التشريق

SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says pilgrims in the pre-Islamic period boasted at the seasonal gathering of their fathers' feeding, protection, and blood-compensation deeds, mentioning nothing else; the verse redirected remembrance to God.
SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r3.anchor: أخرج ابن أبي حاتم عن ابن عباس قال كان أهل الجاهلية يقفون في الموسم يقول الرجل منهم كان أبي يطعم ويحمل الحمالات ويحمل الديات

SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r4.speaker: مجاهد
SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r4.claim: Mujāhid says that after completing rites people stood at the stone-pile and recalled their pre-Islamic fathers and their deeds; this verse was revealed.
SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r4.anchor: وأخرج ابن جرير عن مجاهد قال كانوا اذا قضوا مناسكهم وقفوا عند الجمرة وذكروا أباءهم في الجاهلية وفعال آبائهم

SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says some Bedouins at the ritual standing asked only for rain, abundance, alliances, and worldly good, without mentioning the afterlife; the verse describes them.
SUYUTI-LUBAB:v1p39/r5.anchor: وأخرج ابن أبي حاتم عن ابن عباس قال كان قوم من الأعراب يجيئون إلى الموقف فيقولون اللهم اجعله عام غيث وعام خصب

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r1.speaker: ابن قتيبة
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r1.claim: Ibn Qutayba gives the root meaning of qaḍāʾ as sealing or finishing.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r1.anchor: قال ابن قتيبة : أصل القضاء : الوختم

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r2.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r2.claim: Al-Zajjāj says the language’s varied senses of qaḍāʾ return to bringing something to an end and completion.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r2.anchor: قال الزجاج : القضاء في اللغة : على ضروب كلها ترجع إلى معنى انقطاع الشيء وتمامه

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r5.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r5.claim: Qaḍāʾ can mean finishing an act or rite.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p506#2/r5.anchor: وذكر أهل التفسير أن القضاء في القرآن على خمسة عشر وجها :

BURHAN:v4p115/r6.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p115/r6.speaker: الجمهور
BURHAN:v4p115/r6.claim: On the majority reading, أشد is genitive and coordinates with ذكركم under the comparison kāf, understood as “or like your remembrance, more intense”; this makes remembrance itself a metaphorical remembrance and avoids coordination on a genitive pronoun, forbidden on Hamza’s reading.
BURHAN:v4p115/r6.anchor: وجعلوه مجرورا عطفا على ﴿ ذكركم ﴾ المجرور بكاف التشبيه

ITQAN:v2p414/r19.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p414/r19.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p414/r19.claim: Qaḍā can mean finishing or completing, as in completing the rites.
ITQAN:v2p414/r19.anchor: ومن ذلك القضاء ورد على أوجه 1 الفراغ ﴿ فإذا قضيتم مناسككم ﴾

ITQAN:v2p414/r34.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p414/r34.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p414/r34.claim: Dhikr can refer to remembrance by the tongue, as in the command to remember God as one remembers one’s fathers.
ITQAN:v2p414/r34.anchor: ومن ذلك الذكر ورد على أوجه 1 ذكر اللسان ﴿ فاذكروا الله كذكركم آباءكم ﴾

WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p65/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p65/r1.speaker: مجاهد
WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p65/r1.claim: Mujahid says pre-Islamic Arabs boasted at the pilgrimage gathering about their fathers' deeds, battles, and lineages, so they were told to remember God instead.
WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p65/r1.anchor: قال مجاهد: كان أهل الجاهلية إذا اجتمعوا بالموسم ذكروا فعل آبائهم في الجاهلية وأيامهم وأنسابهم فتفاخروا

WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p65/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p65/r2.speaker: الحسن
WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p65/r2.claim: Al-Hasan says Bedouins used expressions such as ‘by your father’ in conversation, and the verse was revealed about this practice.
WAHIDI-ASBAB:v1p65/r2.anchor: وقال الحسن: كانت الأعراب إذا حدثوا وتكلموا يقولون: وأبيك إنهم لفعلوا كذا وكذا.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p325/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p325/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p325/r4.claim: Following the two kinds of supplicants in 2:200–201, the passage contrasts a sweet-speaking worldly seeker with one who seeks God's pleasure and gives himself for it; the first comes first as in the earlier division. Outer speech should match inner belief.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v2p325/r4.anchor: ومناسبة هذه الآية لما قبلها هو أنه: لما قسم السائلين الله قبل إلى: مقتصر على أمر الدنيا، وسائل حسنة الدنيا والآخرة، والوقاية من النار،
